findings.summary: The home and map search fields set outline-style to none and add no focus ring, so a keyboard user cannot see that the field is focused.
findings.fix: Remove outline-none from .home-search input. The base :focus-visible rule (2px solid var(--color-cyan-400), #00d1ec) then shows on the shell; that outline is 9.83:1 on #151518 and 10.74:1 on #09090b.
findings.evidence: .home-search input compiles to outline-style:none with no :focus border or box-shadow. It is used on / and on the map search. The unlayered rule overrides @layer base :focus-visible.

findings.summary: Contact, subscription, and directory fields suppress the outline, and the replacement focus border and ring stay under 3:1.
findings.fix: Remove outline-none, focus:ring-cyan-500/10, focus:ring-cyan-500/20, and focus:border-cyan-500/50 from contact.css, states.css, and .day-select. Keep the base 2px cyan-400 outline, which is 10.74:1 on #09090b.
findings.evidence: Focus border #056070 on field fill #0a0a0c is 2.74:1 and on card #0f0f11 is 2.66:1. Ring cyan-500 at 10% on #0f0f11 is 1.14:1; at 20% it is 1.36:1. .day-select focus border is 2.76:1 on #151518. Need 3:1.

findings.summary: Text fields and the home search shell are drawn with dark borders on dark fills, so the control boundary is below 3:1.
findings.fix: Use border-zinc-500 (#71717b) on .contact-form fields, .state-directory .search-field input, .day-select, and .search-shell. That border is 3.97:1 on card #0f0f11, 4.10:1 on fill #0a0a0c, and 3.78:1 on shell #151518.
findings.evidence: Border #27272a on fill #0a0a0c is 1.33:1; fill #0a0a0c on card #0f0f11 is 1.03:1. Search shell border #2a2a2f on #09090b is 1.39:1 and shell fill #151518 on #09090b is 1.09:1. Need 3:1.

findings.summary: Moderate and major flood markers put 10px bold glyphs in near-black on dark red fills, so the category numbers miss 4.5:1.
findings.fix: Stop using one ink for every marker. Set the glyph to #ffffff for moderate and major (4.70:1 on #e11d48, 6.47:1 on #b91c1c). Keep #09090b on action, minor, normal, and stale fills, where it already clears 4.5:1.
findings.evidence: canvas.css sets color:#09090b at 0.625rem/700. Moderate fill #e11d48 is 4.24:1. Major fill #b91c1c is 3.07:1. Fills are the inline --marker-fill values in app/javascript/lib/map_markers.js:4-5. Need 4.5:1.

findings.summary: Some links have no underline, and their color is too close to nearby text to identify them without relying on color.
findings.fix: Underline these links at rest: .state-link, .leaflet-popup-content a, .leaflet-control-attribution a, .contact-hero .value a, and the gauge .featured-trend a / .section-link rules. Hover color alone is not a second cue.
findings.evidence: cyan-400 #00d1ec versus zinc-400 #9f9fa9 is 1.42:1 (need 3:1 when a link is not underlined). Attribution links are color:inherit, so the difference is 1:1, and Leaflet keeps text-decoration:none until hover. The mailto link is #d4d4d8 with no underline.

findings.summary: The current header and footer item is indicated only by switching zinc-400 text to white, with no underline, weight, or border.
findings.fix: On .nav-link[aria-current=page] and .site-footer a[aria-current=page], add a non-color cue such as underline or a 2px bottom border. White #ffffff versus zinc-400 #9f9fa9 is only 2.62:1, so lightness alone is not enough.
findings.evidence: .nav-link is text-zinc-400 #9f9fa9 and no-underline. [aria-current=page] sets only text-white #ffffff. Contrast between those text colors is 2.62:1. The same rule styles the footer current item.

findings.summary: FAQ category buttons do not wrap below the large breakpoint, so at 320px the later categories sit in a horizontal scroller.
findings.fix: Below 64rem, drop overflow-x-auto and shrink-0 on .faq-categories and .category-btn and use flex-wrap (the large layout already stacks them). The five labels need about 622px and the content column is 272px wide.
findings.evidence: Space Grotesk 600 at 16px plus px-4: General 91px, Data & sources 148px, Map & stations 148px, Email Alerts 122px, Glossary 99px, plus gaps about 622px. .faq-categories is overflow-x-auto and buttons are shrink-0 until 64rem.

findings.summary: On the map, the header wordmark and two icon buttons are wider than a 320px row, so the bar forces horizontal scrolling.
findings.fix: Let the brand shrink: add min-w-0 on .site-header .inner and .brand, and allow .name to wrap. At 320px the map header leaves 124px for the name after padding, the mark, gaps, and two 40px buttons; the name is 135px.
findings.evidence: Space Grotesk 600, 18px, letter-spacing -0.025em: WaterLevels.org is 135px. Flex items use min-width:auto, and .inner does not wrap. Other pages have one icon button and about 168px free, so they fit.

findings.summary: The live, contact, and state dots pulse indefinitely, and nothing on the page pauses that motion.
findings.fix: Keep the prefers-reduced-motion block. Also end animate-pulse and animate-ping after a few seconds, or add a pause control. The media query only helps people who already set the OS preference, which does not meet 2.2.2 for everyone else.
findings.evidence: home.css .live-pill .dot, pages.css .contact-hero .pulse .ring, and states.css .state-hero .dot use animate-pulse or animate-ping. gauge/related.css:112 also loops nearby-watch-pulse for 2.4s infinite. base.css only shortens motion inside prefers-reduced-motion.

passed: Body and secondary text: zinc-100 #f4f4f5 on #09090b is 18.10:1, and zinc-400 #9f9fa9 on #09090b is 7.59:1 and on #18181b is 6.75:1 (need 4.5:1). Gray text on white is not used.
Placeholders that set placeholder:text-zinc-400: #9f9fa9 on the search shell #151518 is 6.95:1 and on field fill #0a0a0c is 7.54:1.

Default :focus-visible outline #00d1ec is 10.74:1 on #09090b and 9.56:1 on #18181b. Buttons, links, summaries, and checkboxes do not remove it. Skip-link text #09090b on #00d1ec is 10.74:1; its white outline on #09090b is 19.90:1.
Button text #09090b on cyan-500 #00b6d4 is 8.19:1 and on blue-500 #3280ff is 5.37:1. Submit-gradient samples from cyan-500 to blue-500 stay at or above 5.37:1.
Large gradient headings on #09090b: cyan-400 10.74:1, midpoint #25bbfc 9.09:1, blue-400 7.59:1; contact accent to blue-500 ends at 5.37:1 (need 3:1).

Flood and station status include a text label with the dot (Nominal, Offline, or the flood category). Map legend items also name the shape. Status text colors on the card surfaces clear 4.5:1; the lowest checked is rose-400 #ff6880 on #0f0f11 at 6.88:1.
Field errors are text-rose-400 words. Flash notice #53eafd on #081a1f is 12.36:1 and flash alert #ffa3ae on #220c13 is 9.82:1.
Icon buttons: zinc-400 #9f9fa9 on #09090b is 7.59:1 and on #18181b is 6.75:1; zinc-300 #d4d4d8 on #18181b is 11.99:1 (need 3:1).
Marker cluster counts: white on cyan-500 at 55% over #18181b is #ffffff on #0b6f81, 5.83:1. Legend swatches on #18181b clear 3:1; the lowest is red-600 #e40016 at 3.64:1.
prefers-reduced-motion in base.css sets animation-duration and transition-duration to 0.01ms and scroll-behavior to auto.
The only theme is dark (color-scheme: dark, bg-zinc-950). There is no light palette and no dark: variant to recheck.
Viewport is width=device-width, initial-scale=1 with no maximum-scale, and reviewed font sizes use rem, so 200% browser zoom is not blocked in source.
Disabled locate control: after opacity 0.6, zinc-300 text on the faded button is still 4.60:1.
notes: Ratios use WCAG 2 relative luminance on 8-bit sRGB. Tailwind v4 OKLCH stops were chroma-mapped into gamut first. In-gamut zinc stops did not change: zinc-400 is #9f9fa9 and zinc-950 is #09090b. Alpha blends are sRGB source-over.
zinc-400 #9f9fa9 on white #ffffff is 2.62:1, but no reviewed public surface puts gray text on white.
zinc-500 #71717b on #09090b is 4.12:1. Public styles do not use text-zinc-500.

Author checkbox borders would fail (zinc-700 #3f3f46 on #09090b is 1.91:1), but appearance is not none, so the painted control is the user-agent widget under color-scheme:dark. Map filters only set accent-color. Those native widgets were not measured.
Major-flood triangle fill #b91c1c against the map canvas #18181b is 2.74:1. Dark Matter tiles replace that canvas, so contrast against live tiles was not proven.
Site header is in normal flow (overlay is false). .county-head is sticky top-0 with no scroll-padding, so 2.4.11 Focus Not Obscured could not be proven from source.
Disabled history toolbar text after group opacity 0.4 is 2.02:1, and locked range labels #52525c on #101013 are 2.46:1. 1.4.3 and 1.4.11 exempt inactive controls, so those are not filed.

The map canvas is a two-dimensional view and is exempt from 1.4.10. Gauge .segmented is overflow-x-auto and the measurements table scrolls inside .scroll; that table is the two-dimensional exception. Neither is on the 12 URLs. 320px layout was not rendered.

Hydrograph series colors are set in app/javascript/controllers/hydrograph_controller.js, outside the stylesheet scope, and were not measured. JavaScript map and chart motion was not checked for matchMedia.
No prefers-contrast, forced-colors, or prefers-reduced-transparency rules. Those queries are not WCAG 2.2 AA requirements by themselves.
Gauge breadcrumbs use zinc-400 for every link with no underline. They are not on the 12 URLs. The separator is aria-hidden; zinc-700 #3f3f46 on #09090b is 1.91:1.
